# Suite page stepper skips "human" without human review

## What to build

The suite page's phase stepper always shows `features · integration · e2e · human · apply`, even when the suite was started without `--human-review`. `src/web/assets/shell.js` already exports `visiblePhases(phases, humanReview)`, which returns the phase keys without `"human"` when `humanReview` is false (unit-tested in `src/web/assets/shell.test.ts`). Rework `src/web/assets/suitepage.js` so the stepper works by phase **key** instead of the fixed indexes 3 (human) and 4 (apply) it uses today, and build it from `visiblePhases(PHASES, s.humanReview)`. The suite JSON already carries `suite.humanReview` (schema `src/suite/state.ts:48`). No server change.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `src/web/assets/suitepage.js` (line 8) — `const PHASES = ["features", "integration", "e2e", "human", "done"];`
- `src/web/assets/suitepage.js` (lines 280–306) — `currentPhase(d)` returns an index 0–4; `renderHeader(d)` labels index 4 as `apply`/`applied`/`done`/failed status, calls `renderPhaseStepper(..., cur, cur === 4)` and marks `children[Math.min(cur, 4)]` red when the suite failed or was aborted
- `src/web/assets/suitepage.js` (lines 178–183) — the graph already draws `@human` only when `s.humanReview`
- `src/web/assets/shell.js` — `visiblePhases`, `renderPhaseStepper`, `phaseStates`
- `src/suite/state.ts` (line 34, line 48) — suite statuses and `humanReview`

## Patterns to follow

**Plain browser ES modules, helpers from shell.js:**
```js
import { createDrawer, hideSummaryCard, progressText, renderPhaseStepper, showSummaryCard, summaryCardOpen } from "/assets/shell.js";
```

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `src/web/assets/suitepage.js`

- **IMPLEMENT**: make `currentPhase(d)` return a key: `"done"` when the suite status is `applied` or `done`, `"human"` when `d.reviewWaiting`, `"e2e"` when `s.review`, `"integration"` when integrating or anything is merged, else `"features"`.
- **IMPLEMENT**: in `renderHeader(d)`, `const phases = visiblePhases(PHASES, s.humanReview)` and `const cur = phases.indexOf(currentPhase(d))`. Labels: the `"done"` key keeps today's label logic (`applied` / `done` / the failed or aborted status / `apply`); other keys are their own name. Pass `cur === phases.length - 1` as the `done` argument, and mark `children[cur]` red when the suite failed or was aborted.
- **IMPORTS**: add `visiblePhases` to the existing `/assets/shell.js` import.
- **GOTCHA**: a suite waiting for the human review only happens with `humanReview` true, so `"human"` is always in the list when `currentPhase` returns it. Do not change `PHASES` itself.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx eslint src/web/assets/suitepage.js && npx vitest run src/suite src/web`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A suite started with `--web` and without `--human-review` shows `features · integration · e2e · apply` (no `human` pill)
- [ ] With `--human-review`, the `human` pill shows before `apply` and is current while the suite waits for the review
- [ ] When the suite is applied every pill is done; a failed or aborted suite marks the current pill red, as today
- [ ] Tests pass: `npx vitest run src/suite src/web`

## Validation commands

```bash
npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint .
npx vitest run src/suite src/web
```

Run every command with the graph-execution run variables unset, so the tests never touch a live run:
`env -u GRAPH_EXECUTION_RUNS_ROOT -u GRAPH_EXECUTION_RUN_ID -u GRAPH_EXECUTION_READY_FILE <command>`.
Stop only processes you started, by PID. Never use `pkill`/`killall` by name or pattern: other agents and graph-execution itself run on this machine.
